capability.description: The nine tracked support capabilities. Support is per-capability, never global.

capability_status.description: supported = implemented and exercised by a test in this repo. partial = implemented for a subset, limits stated. documented_only = we hold references but no executable support. unsupported = not implemented. blocked = cannot be implemented here, blocker recorded.

evidence_class.description: Kept separate in every report. declared = stated by an author/manifest. extracted = read mechanically from an artifact. derived = produced by our analysis. observed = seen in an executed run. unresolved = insufficient evidence.

verification_state.description: documented = written from sources only. build_tested = its build/validation commands ran here and passed. game_tested = executed against the running game.

operation.description: What a modification does to a target. Determines composition, not merely overlap.

version_range.description: Version constraint in the ecosystem's own syntax where one exists, otherwise a comma-separated set of comparators.

target.description: A precise modification target. A semantic label alone never establishes an interaction.

container.description: File or package the target lives in.

label.description: Navigation aid only. Never sufficient evidence.

condition.description: A precondition that must hold for a statement to apply.

source.description: id of a record in sources.yaml

locator.description: Anchor, line range, selector, or quoted phrase inside the source.

analysis_coverage.description: What an analysis actually looked at, and what it could not look at. Required so a clean result is never read as a guarantee.
